items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I loved the way James Chirillo played with him

ctx.x: Greg Cohen. And so between me and Greg, we did most of Kenny’s gigs in the last couple of years. I loved playing with him. I liked the fact that he had a different approach to playing that music completely. In other words, he liked the openness, I loved the way James Chirillo played with him, because I felt like there was a lot of space. And I love space in music. And I don’t feel sometimes there is enough of it. It gets a little crowded there. And I never felt that way on Kenny’s gigs. I felt there was so much —…
He wanted it to be good.
